When composing the task context, state the time together with its timezone (e.g. 起始时间00:00:00+08:00) and never strip the timezone; when extracting, normalize to UTC in 24-hour HH:mm:ssZ format (e.g. 00:00:00 stated as 北京时间 (UTC+8) → 16:00:00Z) and report a format error when no timezone is stated.

endTime.description: Daily end time of the energy-saving window. Values carry an explicit UTC offset (e.g. 12:00:00+08:00, 北京时间). When composing the task context, state the time together with its timezone (e.g. 结束时间12:00:00+08:00) and never strip the timezone; when extracting, normalize to UTC in 24-hour HH:mm:ssZ format (e.g. 12:00:00 stated as 北京时间 (UTC+8) → 04:00:00Z) and report a format error when no timezone is stated.

operationType.description: Operation type of the RAN energy-saving task; allowed values are listed in the enum

region.description: Coverage region of the energy-saving task; must be a specific physical area name, e.g. Songshan Lake Management Committee

energyTarget.description: Energy-saving target, exactly one of two mutually exclusive legal forms: (1) quantitative - a pure percentage number, e.g. 30% (direction is expressed by energyTargetDirection); (2) qualitative - 在满足任务上下文的条件下进行最大化节能. When composing the task target, keep the user stated value verbatim. When extracting or validating: if a target value is stated but matches neither legal form (e.g. vague statements like 再往下压一压), report a format error; if no target is stated at all, extract null without error (the field is optional). Example: user text 总功耗降低30% maps to energyTarget=30%.

energyTargetDirection.description: Direction of the energy target, derived from user wording: 降低/下降/压降 → reduce; 提升/上升 → increase. If no direction word appears in the task, default to reduce (energy-saving tasks reduce the metric by definition).
